analysis_status: conditional post-detection-identifiability decomposition; model structure and five-of-six rule were frozen before opportunity coefficients were inspected

ecological_read.supported: Current focal-response-excluded opportunity is more consistently associated with current-period detectability/activity than with latent link-state transitions under the simple detection model. Detection-only receives frozen support in four of six transitions; the latent state component meets the frozen support rule in only one of six.
ecological_read.not_supported: The predeclared five-of-six rule for a general opportunity effect on latent colonization/persistence fails decisively.
ecological_read.consequence: The strong binary-turnover opportunity association must not be interpreted as a general ecological rewiring mechanism. A substantial part of the signal is compatible with detecting active pollinators more readily when current opportunity is high.
ecological_read.optimizer_sensitivity: The primary frozen result remains state 1/6 versus detection 4/6. A post-result stricter optimizer-stability sensitivity yields state 0/6 versus detection 2/6, strengthening rather than weakening the no-general-state conclusion without retroactively redefining the primary test.

not_established: opportunity causally changes latent link state
the simple occupancy model is the true ecological process
claim_ceiling: The pre-frozen opportunity decomposition does not support a general latent-state rewiring effect: state-side support is 1/6 versus a frozen 5/6 requirement, while detection-side support occurs in 4/6 transitions. A post-result stricter optimizer sensitivity yields 0/6 versus 2/6 and cannot be used to rewrite the primary rule.

post_result_optimizer_reliability_sensit.criterion: best fit converged, all deterministic starts converged, and multi-start NLL range <= 1e-6
post_result_optimizer_reliability_sensit.role: post-result robustness only; does not redefine the pre-frozen primary state/detection effect rule
post_result_optimizer_reliability_sensit.interpretation: Requiring stronger optimizer agreement does not rescue a latent-state opportunity effect; it removes the lone primary state-supported transition and reduces detection-side support from 4/6 to 2/6.
